title: UDLF deployment config — Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
description: Config for `platform: defender-for-endpoint`. MDE custom detection rules: schedule, alert, impacted entities, response actions, scoping. Query lives in `detection_content`.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `defender-for-endpoint::0.1.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`. MDE has no `Critical`.

scheduling.description: How often the query runs. MDE couples frequency to lookback: 24H/30d, 12H/48h, 3H/12h, 1H/4h, NRT continuous. Maps to `schedule`.

alert.description: How the alert presents when the rule fires. Maps to `detectionAction.alertTemplate`.

title.description: Alert name. Overrides the detection title for this deployment. Maps to `detectionAction.alertTemplate.title`.

description.description: Alert description for analysts. Overrides `detection_context.description`. Maps to `alertTemplate.description`.

category.description: MDE threat category for the alert. Microsoft's own taxonomy, not ATT&CK. Gates which techniques the UI offers.

recommendation.description: Recommended response steps shown with the alert. Maps to `detectionAction.alertTemplate.recommendation`.

impacted_entities.description: Query columns identifying the affected assets. At least one of device, mailbox or user is required. Maps to `alertTemplate.impactedAssets`.

device.description: Query column identifying the affected device.

mailbox.description: Query column identifying the affected mailbox.

user.description: Query column identifying the affected user.

actions.description: Automated response actions on entities found by the query. These change endpoint, file and identity state. Maps to `detectionAction.responseActions`.

devices.description: Actions applied to devices found by the query.

isolate_device.description: Network-isolate the device. `Full` cuts off every application and service; `Selective` leaves a limited set reachable.

collect_investigation_package.description: Collect a forensic investigation package from the device.

run_antivirus_scan.description: Run a full Microsoft Defender Antivirus scan on the device.

initiate_investigation.description: Start an automated investigation of the device.

restrict_app_execution.description: Restrict the device to running only Microsoft-signed binaries.

files.description: Actions applied to files found by the query.

allow_block.description: Allow or block a file across managed devices.

action.description: Whether to allow or block the file. Only one may be selected per detection rule.

identifier.description: Query column holding the file hash to act on. Must exist in the query results.

groups.description: Which device groups the action applies to.

selection.description: `All` applies to every managed device; `Specific` requires `device_groups`.

device_groups.description: Named device groups the action applies to.

quarantine_file.description: Query column holding the hash of the file to stop and quarantine.

users.description: Actions applied to users found by the query.

mark_as_compromised.description: Query column identifying the user whose Entra ID risk level is raised to high.

disable_user.description: Query column identifying the user to temporarily block from signing in on premises.

force_password_reset.description: Query column identifying the user prompted to change password at next sign-in.

scope.description: Which devices the rule runs against. Maps to `detectionAction.organizationalScope`.

selection.description: `All` scopes to every device; `Specific` requires `device_groups`. Maps to `organizationalScope.scopeType`.

device_groups.description: Named device groups the rule is scoped to. Maps to `detectionAction.organizationalScope.scopeNames`.

exclusions.description: Tuning exclusions appended to the deployed query in order, each with a reason.

reason.description: Why this exclusion exists. Required so tuning decisions stay auditable.

let.description: KQL `let` bindings emitted before the exclusion query and referenceable from it. Values are inserted verbatim.

query.description: KQL appended to the base query.

advanced.description: Escape hatch for unmodelled MDE API properties. Passed through verbatim and unvalidated; prefer a modelled field.
